0.long_answer: Type 1 diabetes mellitus is an autoimmune disorder in which the immune system attacks and destroys the insulin-producing beta cells of the pancreas. This condition, when present before pregnancy, can result in poor glycemic control during early pregnancy. Elevated blood sugar levels during the organogenesis period increase the risk of fetal malformations, making pregestational type 1 diabetes a significant concern for maternal and fetal health.
